printedCards.name: Fog on the Bay
printedCards.text:
Locations on the same row are connected to one another.
Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
printedCards.backText:
Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy engaged with the lead investigator. Place the set-aside blue key on Oceiros Marsh.
Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck.
Each investigator loses each of their clues.
Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell.
Advance the act directly to act 2a (do not resolve act 1b).

printedCards.name: Unchanging as the Sea
printedCards.text:
Locations on the same row are connected to one another.
Forced - When an investigator is captured: Advance this agenda.
Forced - When this agenda advances: Move all doom on it to the next agenda.
printedCards.backText:
Each investigator is captured. Place each of their keys on Holding Cells. If Oceiros Marsh is in play, set him aside, out of play. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck.
Reveal the Lighthouse Basement. Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.)
Advance the act directly to act 3a (do not resolve act 2b).

printedCards.name: The Tide Rises
printedCards.text: Locations on the same row are connected to one another.
printedCards.backText:
Search all out-of-play areas for Oceiros Marsh and spawn him in the Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths).
Remove each [[Falcon Point]] location from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them). Move each enemy and investigator at those locations to Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths). Each other card at those locations is discarded.
Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels.

printedCards.name: Terror at Falcon Point
printedCards.text:
Oceiros Marsh gets +2 [per_investigator] health.
Locations on the same row are connected to one another.
(Beware - the scenario may not end when this agenda advances, but the tide will continue to rise...)
printedCards.backText: Find the 4 bottommost locations that can have their flood levels increased. Increase each of their flood levels. If you cannot, proceed to (→R3). Otherwise, flip this agenda back over and continue playing.

printedCards.name: The Lighthouse
printedCards.text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues before the agenda advances.
printedCards.backText:
Spawn the set-aside Oceiros Marsh enemy in Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage, exhausted. Place the set-aside blue key on him.
Shuffle each set-aside copy of Worth His Salt into the encounter deck.
Put the set-aside Lighthouse Basement location into play directly below Lighthouse Stairwell.
Advance the agenda directly to agenda 2a (do not resolve agenda 1b).

printedCards.name: Finding the Path
printedCards.text: Objective - If an investigator enters Lighthouse Basement before the agenda advances, advance.
printedCards.backText:
If Oceiros Marsh is in play, add him to the victory display.
Put Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Upper Depths) and Sunken Grotto (Final Depths) into play directly below Sunken Grotto (Lower Depths). Then, put random set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations into play until there are exactly 4 locations on each row, except for the row with the Lantern Room. (See Campaign Guide for diagram.)
Shuffle each set-aside copy of Taken Captive into the encounter deck.
Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).

printedCards.name: Worshippers of the Deep
printedCards.text:
Forced - At the end of the investigation phase: Each investigator at a fully flooded location must either take 3 damage or move to the location directly below their location.
Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. (Hint - You may wish to find what you came for before you leave this place. The black and red keys represent the objects you need the most.)
printedCards.backText:
If at least 1 investigator resigned from the Moon Room:
The underwater tunnels seem to go on forever, stretching into murk-ridden eddies. Dark salt water crashes against the glass helmet of your suit. After what feels like an eternity, you burst into the cold evening air, chilled to the bone. You pull the heavy suit off, piece by piece, the moment you reach the shore.
(→R1)
If each investigator who resigned did so from the Falcon Point Gatehouse:
You flee into the lonely woods, panting for air. Somehow, you've escaped the denizens of the deep once more.(→R2)

printedCards.name: Falcon Point Gatehouse
printedCards.text:
Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded.
[action]: Resign. You head back into the woods, leaving the lighthouse and its mysteries behind. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act.
printedCards.backText: Falcon Point Gatehouse cannot be fully flooded.

printedCards.name: Lighthouse Stairwell
printedCards.text:
Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.
[fast] If there are any [[Relic]] story assets currently set aside: Add 1 of them to your hand.
printedCards.backText: Lighthouse Stairwell cannot be fully flooded.

printedCards.name: Lantern Room
printedCards.text:
Lantern Room cannot be flooded.
Forced - After Lantern Room is revealed: Place the set-aside white key on it.
printedCards.backText: Lantern Room cannot be flooded.

printedCards.name: Falcon Point Cliffside
printedCards.text:
Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded.
[fast] If you control the white key: Using the white key, you peer out into the dark, stormy horizon, and something sparks in your memories. Read Flashback XII in the Campaign Guide.
printedCards.backText: Falcon Point Cliffside cannot be fully flooded.

printedCards.name: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage
printedCards.text:
Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded.
Forced - After Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage is revealed: Place the set-aside yellow key on it.
printedCards.backText: Lighthouse Keeper's Cottage cannot be fully flooded.

printedCards.text: [fast] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Look at the revealed side of a Tidal Tunnel location on this row.
printedCards.backText: The door leading into the basement of the lighthouse is locked tight. You cannot enter this location unless you control the blue key.

printedCards.text:
Clues cannot be discovered from Shrine to Hydra except by investigating.
While an investigator at Shrine to Hydra controls the green key, Shrine to Hydra gets -3 shroud.
Forced - After Shrine to Hydra is revealed: Place the set-aside red key on it.

printedCards.name: Deep One Nursery
printedCards.text:
[fast] If you control the purple key: You compare the purple key to the oversized eggs littering the flooded chamber and recall something. Read Flashback XIII in the Campaign Guide.
Forced - After Deep One Nursery is revealed: Increase its flood level.

printedCards.name: The Moon Room
printedCards.text:
[action] If The Moon Room is unflooded: Resign. You don one of the empty diving suits and dive into the reflecting pool. If you control the black or red keys, place each one you control on the current act.
Forced - After The Moon Room is revealed: Increase its flood level.

printedCards.name: Sunken Archives
printedCards.text:
Clues cannot be discovered at Sunken Archives while it is flooded.
Forced - After Sunken Archives is revealed: It becomes fully flooded. Place the set-aside black key on it.

printedCards.name: Pump Room
printedCards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) or [agility] (2). If you succeed, choose two locations. Decrease the flood level of one location and increase the flood level of the other (if you succeed by 2 or more, you may instead choose just one location and decrease its flood level).

printedCards.name: Captured!
printedCards.text:
The first time an investigator is captured, read the following:
You are bound and dragged deep underground, then thrown into a sealed prison cell, surrounded on all sides by dripping stone walls. Your cries fall on deaf ears as your captor's footsteps fade into the distance.
Remove the captured investigator from their location and return each asset in that investigator's hand slots to their hand.
Turn that investigator's mini-card sideways to indicate that they have been captured. Captured investigators cannot move, fight, or be engaged.
Flip this story card over to its "Holding Cells" side and put it into play. It is not on any existing row or column, and is only connected to Sunken Grotto locations through its connection icons. Place the captured investigator in Holding Cells.
From now on, whenever an investigator is captured, resolve this same effect (return each asset in their hand slots to their hand, turn their mini-card sideways, and place them in Holding Cells).

printedCards.name: Holding Cells
printedCards.text:
Holding Cells cannot be flooded. 
Enemies cannot enter or spawn at Holding Cells (if one would spawn here, spawn it at any Sunken Grotto instead).
[action]: Test [combat] (3) to break the bars or [agility] (3) to pick the locks. If you control the yellow key, this test automatically succeeds. If you succeed, free an investigator who is captured here.

printedCards.name: Oceiros Marsh
printedCards.text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Oceiros Marsh gets +2 evade while his location is flooded.
Forced - After Oceiros Marsh is successfully evaded: For each point you succeeded by, take control of 1 key on him.
Forced - After Oceiros Marsh attacks you during the enemy phase: You are captured. Place each of your keys on Oceiros Marsh.

printedCards.name: Deep One Nursemaid
printedCards.text:
Aloof. Retaliate.
While Deep One Nursemaid is unengaged, each other [[Deep One]] enemy at its location or connecting locations gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
Forced - After Deep One Nursemaid engages you: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. That card loses surge.

printedCards.name: Deep One Hatchling
printedCards.text:
Surge.
Forced - After you engage Deep One Hatchling: Either lose 1 action or it attacks you.
Forced - After you defeat Deep One Hatchling: Move the nearest ready, unengaged [[Deep One]] enemy once toward your location. That enemy loses aloof during this movement.

printedCards.name: Hideous Lullaby
printedCards.text: Revelation - If there are no [[Deep One]] enemies in play, Hideous Lullaby gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Deep One]] enemy with the highest fight value. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

printedCards.name: Kiss of Brine
printedCards.text:
Revelation - Test [combat] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 2 if you are at a flooded location. If you fail, take 1 damage and put Kiss of Brine into play in your threat area.
You cannot gain resources or draw cards.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Discard Kiss of Brine.

printedCards.name: Totality
printedCards.text:
Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, put Totality into play in your threat area.
Forced - After you enter a flooded location: Take 1 horror.
Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard Totality.

printedCards.name: Worth His Salt
printedCards.text:
Revelation - Attach to Oceiros Marsh, even if he is in the victory display.
Forced - After Oceiros Marsh moves via his hunter keyword, if he is unengaged: Resolve his hunter keyword again. He cannot attack this phase. (Limit once per round.)
Forced - When Oceiros Marsh attacks: This attack deals +1 damage and +1 horror. Discard this card.

printedCards.name: Taken Captive
printedCards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you are captured; place each of your keys on Holding Cells.

printedCards.name: The Initiation (v. I)
printedCards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
printedCards.backText:
Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. Check Campaign Log.
- If a jailbreak is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log, spawn the set-aside [[Suspect]] enemy at a [[Third Floor]] location, or at the Grand Entryway if a [[Third Floor]] location is not in play (ignoring that enemy's revelation ability). Place the set-aside blue key on that enemy.
- Otherwise, the lead investigator searches the encounter deck for a [[Cultist]] enemy and spawns it in a connecting location. Shuffle the encounter deck.

printedCards.name: The Initiation (v. II)
printedCards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
printedCards.backText:
Remove 2 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag. Check Campaign Log.
- If a jailbreak is listed under "Memories Recovered" in your Campaign Log, spawn the set-aside [[Suspect]] enemy at a [[Third Floor]] location, or at the Grand Entryway if a [[Third Floor]] location is not in play (ignoring that enemy's revelation ability). That enemy enters play exhausted.
- Otherwise, nothing else happens.

printedCards.name: What Lurks Below (v. I)

printedCards.backText: Add 4 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.

printedCards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Thomas Dawson story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, Thomas Dawson does not take up an ally slot. That investigator may also take control of 1 spent key on the scenario reference card.

printedCards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
In your Campaign Log, record Dagon has awakened.
(→R1)

printedCards.name: The First Oath
printedCards.text:
Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with.
[fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location.
Objective - If each surviving investigator is at Grand Entryway and the investigators have "unlocked the entrance to the caves," advance.
printedCards.backText:
If a [[Suspect]] enemy is in play, remove it from the game.
Remove each location other than Grand Entryway from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues on them), discarding each card at those locations.
Shuffle the set-aside Tidal Tunnel locations and put each of them into play.
Increase the flood level of each location.
Shuffle each set-aside Syzygy and Tidal Alignment card into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.

printedCards.name: The Second Oath
printedCards.text:
Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with.
[fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location.
Objective - If an investigator has "unlocked the final depths," advance.
printedCards.backText:
Put the set-aside Lair of Dagon location into play, fully flooded.
Put the set-aside Dagon enemy into play at Lair of Dagon, (Deep in Slumber) side faceup.
Check the current agenda.
- If it is agenda 1a, add 10 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.
- If it is agenda 2a, add 5 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.

printedCards.name: The Third Oath
printedCards.text:
Each [[Suspect]] enemy gets +1 [per_investigator] health, loses aloof, and cannot be parleyed with.
[fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Discard each [[Obstacle]] card attached to your location.
Objective - Disrupt the Order's ritual by placing clues on this act. If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on this act, advance.
printedCards.backText:
In your Campaign Log, record the Order's ritual was disrupted.
- If Dagon (Deep in Slumber) is in play, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon still slumbers.
- If Dagon (Awakened and Enraged) is in play or in the victory display, in your Campaign Log, record Dagon has awakened.
(→R1)

printedCards.name: Grand Entryway
printedCards.text:
Grand Entryway is connected to each [[Cave]] location, and vice versa.
[action] Resign. You've had enough of this place.
[action] Investigators at the Grand Entryway spend the purple key and 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you have "unlocked the entrance to the caves".

printedCards.name: Hall of Blood
printedCards.text:
Forced - After Hall of Blood is revealed: Place the set-aside red key on it.
Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Hall of Blood: Take 1 horror.

printedCards.name: Hall of the Deep
printedCards.text:
[action] Spend the red key: There is an audible click as the crest of blood fits into the stone altar. Put the set-aside Y'ha-nthlei Statue story asset into play under your control, [[Cursed]] side faceup.
Forced - After Hall of the Deep is revealed: Increase its flood level.

printedCards.name: Foul Corridors
printedCards.text: [action] Spend the black key: Remember that you have "unlocked the third floor."

printedCards.name: Hall of Loyalty
printedCards.text:
[fast] Spend the blue, red, white, or yellow key: Choose 3 of the following - 
- Heal 1 damage.
- Draw 2 cards.
- Gain 3 resources.
- Add 4 [bless] tokens to the chaos bag.

printedCards.name: Hall of Rebirth
printedCards.text: Forced - After you reveal Hall of Rebirth: Draw the set-aside Apostle of Dagon enemy.

printedCards.name: Hall of Silence
printedCards.text:
Forced - After Hall of Silence is revealed: Place the set-aside purple key on it.
Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.
printedCards.backText: Investigators cannot move to Third Floor Hall unless an investigator has "unlocked the third floor."

printedCards.name: Doorway to the Depths
printedCards.text:
Forced - After Doorway to the Depths is revealed: Place the set-aside green key on the location with the most clues.
[action] Investigators at the Doorway to the Depths spend the green key and 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you have "unlocked the final depths."

printedCards.name: Lair of Dagon
printedCards.text:
Forced - After you enter Lair of Dagon: Test your lowest skill (3). If you fail, take 1 horror.
[action]: Test [willpower] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, place 1 of your clues on the current act. You may spend 1 key to place 1 more of your clues on the current act.

printedCards.name: Dagon
printedCards.text:
Dagon is slumbering. He cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects.
Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Place 1 resource on Dagon. Then, if there are at least 1 [per_investigator] +2 resources on Dagon, flip him.
[action] Spend 1 key: Remove 1 resource from Dagon.

printedCards.name: Dagon
printedCards.text:
Massive.
Dagon gets +6 [per_investigator] health.
Forced - After an investigator at this location fails a skill test: Ready Dagon. Dagon attacks that investigator.

printedCards.name: Apostle of Dagon
printedCards.text:
Apostle of Dagon gets +1 [per_investigator] health.
Forced - After Apostle of Dagon enters play: Place the set-aside black key on it.
Forced - When an investigator deals 1 or more damage to Apostle of Dagon: Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag.

printedCards.name: Cerenerian Deep One
printedCards.text:
Prey - Lowest [willpower].
Hunter.
Forced - After Cerenerian Deep One engages you: Add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag.

printedCards.name: Fulfill the Oaths
printedCards.text:
Revelation - If it is...
- ... act 1, test [agility] (3).
- ... act 2, test [agility] (3), then [combat] (2).
- ... act 3, test [agility] (3), then [combat] (2), then [intellect] (2).
For each of these skill tests you fail, take 1 damage.

printedCards.name: Secret Gathering
printedCards.text: Revelation - Add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag. Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, place 1 doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy and take 1 horror (2 horror instead if 1 or more [curse] tokens were revealed during this test).

printedCards.name: Esoteric Ritual
printedCards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, choose and discard 2 cards from your hand or discard an asset you control (if 1 or more [curse] tokens were revealed during this test, do both instead).

printedCards.name: Heralds of the Deep
printedCards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3) (5 instead if your location is flooded). For each point you fail by, add 1 [curse] token to the chaos bag (if you cannot, Heralds of the Deep gains surge).

printedCards.name: Stone Barrier
printedCards.text:
Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a Stone Barrier attached. If attached location is flooded, Stone Barrier gains surge.
While Stone Barrier is ready, investigators cannot move out of attached location.
[action]: Test [agility] (1), [combat] (2), or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, exhaust Stone Barrier.

printedCards.name: Y'ha-nthlei Statue
printedCards.text:
[fast] Exhaust Y'ha-nthlei Statue and add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag: Deal 1 damage to a [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location.
[action] Spend the blue, white, red, or yellow key: Ready Y'ha-nthlei Statue and flip it to its other side.

printedCards.name: Y'ha-nthlei Statue
printedCards.text:
[fast] Exhaust Y'ha-nthlei Statue: Deal 1 damage to a [[Humanoid]] enemy at your location.
[fast] Exhaust Y'ha-nthlei Statue: Remove 2 [curse] tokens from the chaos bag and replace them with an equal number of [bless] tokens.

printedCards.name: Under the Surface
printedCards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
printedCards.backText: Shuffle the set-aside Lloigor enemy and the set-aside Aquatic Abomination enemy into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.

printedCards.name: Celestial Alignment
printedCards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.
printedCards.backText:
If Hydra is in play, flip her to her (Awakened and Enraged) side.
If Dagon is in play and slumbering, flip him to his (Awakened and Enraged) side.

printedCards.name: The Flood
printedCards.text:
If an [[Ancient One]] enemy is slumbering, flip it to its (Awakened and Enraged) side.
Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at a fully flooded location, you struggle for air: When your turn ends, if you did not enter an unflooded or partially flooded location during your turn, take 5 direct damage.

printedCards.name: Back into the Depths
printedCards.text: Objective - If each investigator is at Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei and the investigators possess each of the following keys (blue, red, yellow, and green), you may choose to advance.
printedCards.backText:
Remove each location other than Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei from the game (or add them to the victory display if they have Victory X and no clues remaining). Discard each card at those locations.
Put set-aside locations into play as shown in the Campaign Guide, following the "Act 2 Setup" instructions. (Note that the number of Y'ha-nthlei locations used and the arrangement of the locations varies depending on the number of investigators in the game.)
Put the set-aside Hydra enemy into play in the Lair of Hydra, (Deep in Slumber) side faceup.
Put the set-aside Dagon enemy into play in the Lair of Dagon. Check Campaign Log. If Dagon has awakened, he enters play (Awakened and Enraged) side faceup. If Dagon still slumbers, he enters play (Deep in Slumber) side faceup.

printedCards.name: City of the Deep (v. I)
printedCards.text:
[fast] Either remove 1 [per_investigator] damage from an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location, or investigators at a [[Lair]] location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease the flood level of any non-[[Sanctum]] location in play
Objective - Stop the Deep Ones' ritual by draining the city. If each location in play is unflooded, advance.
printedCards.backText:
Add this card to the victory display.
- If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective.
- If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1).
Victory 2.

printedCards.name: City of the Deep (v. II)
printedCards.text: Objective - Recover the riches of the Deep Ones. If the Lair of Dagon, the Lair of Hydra, and the Vault of Riches with the purple key have no clues on them, advance.
printedCards.backText:
Add this card to the victory display.
- If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective.
- If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1).
Victory 2.

printedCards.name: City of the Deep (v. III)
printedCards.text: Objective - Collapse the vault containing the Deep Ones' riches. If Dagon and Hydra each have at least 4 [per_investigator] damage on them, advance.
printedCards.backText:
Add this card to the victory display.
- If there is another act card in play, you may choose to either continue playing in order to accomplish the objective on that act card, or proceed immediately to (→R1) without fulfilling that objective.
- If there are no other act cards in play, proceed to (→R1).
Victory 2.

printedCards.name: Dark Abyss
printedCards.text:
Forced - After Dark Abyss is revealed: Randomly choose 1 of the set-aside facedown keys and place it on Dark Abyss without looking at it.
Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Dark Abyss: Dark Abyss becomes fully flooded. Increase the flood level of each location connected to Dark Abyss.

printedCards.name: Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei
printedCards.backText: Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Sunken Halls
printedCards.text:
[action] If you control the black key: Place it on Sunken Halls.
Forced - After an enemy enters Sunken Halls, if the black key is on Sunken Halls: Deal 2 damage to that enemy.
printedCards.backText: Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Vault of Riches
printedCards.text: [action] If you control the purple key: Place it on Vault of Riches. Then, choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at any location. Automatically evade that enemy and move it to Vault of Riches. That enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase. (Group limit once per game.)
printedCards.backText: Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Undersea Corridors
printedCards.text:
[action] If you control the white key: Place it on Undersea Corridors.
[fast] If the white key is on Undersea Corridors: Move. Move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
printedCards.backText: Y'ha-nthlei enters play partially flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Statues in the Deep
printedCards.text:
[action] If you control the blue key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.)
Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating this location: Take 1 damage.
printedCards.backText: Y'ha-nthlei Sanctum enters play fully flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Submerged Temple
printedCards.text:
Each [[Deep One]] enemy at this location gets +2 fight.
[action] If you control the green key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.)
printedCards.backText: Y'ha-nthlei Sanctum enters play fully flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Syzygy Chamber
printedCards.text:
[action] If you control the red key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.)
Forced - After any location's flood value is increased: Each investigator at this location takes 1 horror.
printedCards.backText: Y'ha-nthlei Sanctum enters play fully flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Onyx Guardians
printedCards.text:
During the enemy phase, each ready [[Ancient One]] enemy can attack investigators here as if they were engaged.
[action] If you control the yellow key, place it on this location and investigators here spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Automatically evade each [[Ancient One]] enemy. Unflood this location. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot be flooded. (Group limit once per game.)
printedCards.backText: Y'ha-nthlei Sanctum enters play fully flooded (even while it is unrevealed).

printedCards.name: Lair of Dagon
printedCards.text:
Lair of Dagon gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
[fast] Check Campaign Log. If all 7 keys are on locations and the Order's ritual was disrupted: You dig deep into your memories to recall what happened the last time you were here. Read Flashback XIV in the Campaign Guide.

printedCards.name: Lair of Hydra
printedCards.text:
Lair of Hydra gets -1 shroud for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
[action] Place the black, purple, or white key on this location: Deal 3 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy that is not slumbering. (Group limit once per game.)

printedCards.name: Dagon
printedCards.text:
Dagon is slumbering. He cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects.
Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if an investigator is in Lair of Dagon and Dagon is ready: Place 1 doom on him.
[action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either exhaust Dagon or remove 1 doom from him. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on him.

printedCards.name: Dagon
printedCards.text:
Hunter. Massive. Retaliate.
Dagon gets -1 fight for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
Forced - After Dagon is evaded or dealt damage: Do the same to a copy of Dagon's Brood in play, as well.

printedCards.name: Hydra
printedCards.text:
Hydra is slumbering. She cannot attack or engage, and is immune to investigator actions and player card effects.
Forced - At the end of the investigation phase, if an investigator is in Lair of Hydra and Hydra is ready: Place 1 doom on her.
[action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, either exhaust Hydra or remove 1 doom from her. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on her.

printedCards.name: Hydra
printedCards.text:
Hunter. Massive. Retaliate.
Hydra gets -1 fight for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it.
Forced - After Hydra is evaded or dealt damage: Do the same to a copy of Hydra's Brood in play, as well.

printedCards.name: Aquatic Abomination
printedCards.text:
Hunter.
While Aquatic Abomination is moving, fully flooded locations are considered to be connected to one another.
Aquatic Abomination cannot attack during the same phase it moved via its hunter keyword.

printedCards.name: Dagon's Brood
printedCards.text:
Spawn - Lair of Dagon or Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei (whichever is farther from you).
Hunter.
Forced - After Dagon's Brood engages you, if Dagon is in play: Either place 1 doom on Dagon, or Dagon attacks you.

printedCards.name: Hydra's Brood
printedCards.text:
Spawn - Lair of Hydra or Gateway to Y'ha-nthlei (whichever is farther from you).
Hunter.
Forced - After Hydra's Brood engages you, if Hydra is in play: Either place 1 doom on Hydra, or Hydra attacks you.

printedCards.name: Treacherous Depths
printedCards.text:
Peril.
Revelation - You must either (choose one):
- Increase the flood level of your current location.
- Discard assets from your play area with a total resource cost of at least X, where X is your location's shroud value.

printedCards.name: Conspiracy of Deep Ones
printedCards.text:
Peril.
Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each [[Sanctum]] location with a key on it. If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance), or the nearest [[Ancient One]] enemy in play attacks you.

printedCards.name: Thalassophobia
printedCards.text: Revelation - If no investigators are at flooded locations, Thalassophobia gains surge. Otherwise, each investigator at a partially flooded location takes 1 horror, and each investigator at a fully flooded location takes 1 direct horror that cannot be prevented.

printedCards.name: Diving Suit
printedCards.text:
You ignore the Forced ability on the current agenda.
Forced - When any amount of damage would be placed on you: Place 1 of that damage on Diving Suit.
Forced - When Diving Suit leaves play: Remove it from the game.
